mathematical_repair.statement: For m>=1,d>0,a<b and a/d<t<b/d, define k_-=floor((2ma+d)/(2d)) and k_+=floor((2mb+d)/(2d)). If k_-=k_+=k, then floor(mt+1/2)=k by monotonicity of floor; this unit has b=a+1 for each displayed bracket. Agreement is sufficient, not necessary; endpoint disagreement gives no conclusion of nonuniqueness or an actual tie.
proof_steps: the endpoint floors both equal k
monotonicity bounds the interior floor below and above by k
therefore the interior floor equals k
